predicate.label: broadcasts event
predicate.definition: Broadcaster X broadcasts or broadcast coverage of event Y.
includes: explicit broadcast or telecast of Y
a stated event show on X
excludes: rights ownership alone without actual coverage
ordinary attendance or commentary about Y
ambiguous: announced future coverage or rights without realization
generic have or show without event-coverage attachment
predicate.notes: Separate from broadcasts_program for a named regular program; no ownership or exclusive-rights claim is implied.
predicate.scope_notes: Includes: explicit broadcast or telecast of Y; a stated event show on X; historical event coverage. Excludes: broadcasting another program after Y; rights ownership alone without actual coverage; advertisement placement or rejection alone; ordinary attendance or commentary about Y. Ambiguous unless resolved by case-local evidence: announced future coverage or rights without realization; unclear broadcaster versus production role; generic have or show without event-coverage attachment. Separate from broadcasts_program for a named regular program; no ownership or exclusive-rights claim is implied.

rationale: CBS→Super Bowl broadcasting/telecast/right-to-broadcast is the strongest coherent event family. Rights and after-event broadcasts retain the centrally fixed nonactual/wrong-object limits; political support is separate.
